newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel market reform recommendations delayed a wee.
newsitem.headline: Israel market reform recommendations delayed a wee.

text.p: A government committee studying reforms in Israel's capital markets will delay submitting its recommendations until next week, the head of the committee said.
The committee was to have submitted its recommendations to the finance ministry on September 12.
"The delay is due to a technicality only," David Brodett, who is director general of the Finance Ministry, told Reuters.
He declined to elaborate and would not comment on the committee's findings other than to say that some of the recommendations would likely deal with foreign investment.
